pages.text: Two $(l:food/farmers_delight)Farmer's Delight$(/l) add-ons cook the ocean. They use Farmer's Delight's pot, cutting board and knives, so meals follow the same rules as the rest of the pack's food.

$(thing)Ocean's Delight$() cooks vanilla ocean mobs: squid, cod, kelp, sea pickles, pufferfish, guardians and even Elder Guardians. $(thing)Aquaculture Delight$() cooks Aquaculture's fish: perch, halibut, pollock, tuna, catfish, bass and turtle meat.

pages.title: Guardian Soup
pages.text: A one-pot soup made from Guardian parts.

pages.title: Stuffed Squid
pages.text: Squid meals. Cut Tentacles and Squid Rings come from cutting squid.

pages.title: Fish and Chips
pages.text: Aquaculture Delight meals use fillets and fish. Also includes a Neptunium Knife.

pages.title: Neptunium Knife
pages.text: A Farmer's Delight style knife made with Neptunium, for cutting fish.
The same fish also feed automated kitchens: see $(l:food/kitchen_automation)Kitchen Automation$(/l). Hybrid Aquatic's clams cook into Cooked Clam, and Naturalist's clams give Clam Meat.
